front.name: Daybreak Ranger
clauses: {T}: This creature deals 2 damage to target creature with flying.

back.name: Nightfall Predator
clauses: {R}, {T}: This creature fights target creature. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform this creature.
